SELECT id, name FROM cus_supplier WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND UPPER(status_enum) = 'ACTIVE'
AND UPPER(status_enum) = 'INACTIVE'
AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR py_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR wb_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY COALESCE(display_order, 999999), name, created_at DESC

SELECT id, bus_no, name, type_enum, credit_code, legal_representative, address, py_str, wb_str, phone, email, bank_name, bank_account, org_id, display_order, status_enum, note FROM cus_supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT credit_code FROM cus_supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM adm_organization WHERE id = #{orgId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status_enum = 'ACTIVE' AND active_flag = 1
